title: Base-N Arithmetic
description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers in any base from 2 to 36 with exact BigInt math and a full conversion breakdown.
howto: Type the two operands using valid digits for that base (0-9 then A-Z).
Read the result in your base plus the decimal cross-check and conversion steps.

faqs.q: Which digits are allowed in each base?
faqs.a: Digits go 0–9 then letters A–Z. Base 16 allows 0–9 and A–F; base 36 allows all digits and letters. The tool validates every character before computing.

faqs.q: Why can division produce a fraction?
faqs.a: Integer division in another base still follows the same rules: a ÷ b gives a quotient and remainder. Both are converted back to your base so you can verify the result.

faqs.q: Is the arithmetic exact for huge numbers?
faqs.a: Yes — operands are converted with BigInt, so arbitrarily long digit strings compute exactly with no floating-point rounding.
